name: runs-fr — dev
postCreateCommand: set -e; command -v uv >/dev/null || curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/0.13.6/install.sh | sh; "$HOME/.local/bin/uv" tool install --force --python 3.12 --managed-python 'git+https://github.com/derio-net/super-fr#subdirectory=packages/fr'; sudo ln -sf "$HOME/.local/bin/fr" /usr/local/bin/fr; sudo ln -sf "$HOME/.local/bin/uv" /usr/local/bin/uv; fr --version

fr.purpose: build/test runs-fr gateway: go build/test/vet, golangci-lint, esbuild frontend, helm lint/template
